reviewer_notes: The topic is discussed, so A's not_discussed is wrong: Article Seventeen, titled 'PERSONAL AND ACADEMIC FREEDOM', states at C (PDF page 26) that 'academic freedom is basic to the attainment of the educational goals of the Manchester Public Schools', and Article Twenty Four B.2-B.3 (PDF page 35) governs instructional materials - the Administration must notify the Association before changing or selecting a textbook or launching a new education program and the Association may seat a representative on the textbook/new-program committee, while 'The final determination of textbooks will be made by the Board' and is non-grievable. Searches run: 'curriculum', 'lesson plan', 'academic freedom', 'instructional materials', 'teaching methods', 'course of study', 'textbook selection', 'methods of instruction', 'select materials' - nothing else bears on teacher discretion (the p.6 managerial-policy recital is a management-rights clause and does not count). A owes evidence and a page and gives none. B's status and verbatim quote are right, but the clause is on PDF page 35, not the reported 36 (footer '34' = PDF 35, a one-page offset), so B also fails.
